recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6171; any future work should be handled under later subject-expansion issues rather than this DSTU1 decision.
issue_request: FHIR-6171 asked to relax Flag.patient from 1..1 to 0..1 for non-patient flag use cases. Its Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept mandatory cardinality, renamed patient to subject, allowed non-patient subject targets including Location, Group, Organization, and Practitioner, broadened the Flag narrative, and retained patient search while adding subject search.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git-svn commit b56250f4bf, which changed the example from patient to subject and opened up flag.subject in the Flag source. Follow-up commit 4f011f662a rewrote Flag scope and usage to show Patient, Location, Practitioner, and Group subject examples; later QA commits cleaned the wording.
additional_context: Flag is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied Flag issues expanded the same subject target set beyond FHIR-6171: FHIR-10083 added PlanDefinition, Medication, and Procedure examples; FHIR-20380 added PractitionerRole; FHIR-37950 added RelatedPerson. Those later changes explain the current broader target list without contradicting FHIR-6171. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current structuredefinition-Flag.xml defines Flag.subject as 1..1 and includes the requested non-patient targets; bundle-Flag-search-params.xml retains patient search and defines subject search; flag-introduction.xml describes non-patient Flag subjects with examples.
